contentSections.heading: Frequently asked Questions
contentSections.text: Frequently asked Questions 1. What is Tatva Natural Latex and Coir Mattress? Tatva is a eco-friendly firm mattress combining 100% natural latex with high-density coir for firm support and natural cooling. Part of Duroflex's Natural Living Range, it features a biodegradable latex layer with pincore structure for natural ventilation, enhanced by high-density coir for firm structural support. 2. What problem does Tatva Natural Latex and Coir Mattress solve? It addresses allergen sensitivity (100% natural latex is hypoallergenic), heat retention, back pain and poor posture, and the need for responsive support combined with structural firmness. The 100% natural latex structure keeps the mattress fresh and hygienic, reducing sneezing and allergic reactions while maintaining postural alignment. 3. Who is Tatva Natural Latex and Coir Mattress best for? Perfect for people of all ages seeking sustainable, natural, ventilated sleep solutions, those with back pain or joint issues, eco-conscious buyers prioritizing natural materials, hot sleepers needing natural cooling, and individuals with allergies seeking pure natural latex. 4. How does Tatva Natural Latex and Coir Mattress work? The mattress combines multiple layers: 100% natural latex with pin core structure delivers responsive, and high-density coir provides firm structural support and durability; together these layers create natural air circulation, keeping the mattress fresh and regulating temperature. The responsive latex conforms to your body while the firm coir prevents excessive sinking, maintaining proper spinal alignment. 5. How is Tatva Natural Latex and Coir Mattress different from alternatives? Unlike alternatives using synthetic materials, Tatva uses 100% natural latex and high-density coir. The pin core latex structure is unique; it offers this airflow feature. While most latex alternatives sacrifice firmness for comfort (or vice versa), Tatva balances both through the latex-coir combination. 6. How does Tatva Natural Latex and Coir Mattress feel ? Firm — Delivers strong, no-nonsense support without being uncomfortable. The natural latex provides responsive support with natural springiness; the firm coir prevents excessive sinking while maintaining comfort. 7. Does Tatva Natural Latex and Coir Mattress come with a warranty? Yes, it comes with 10-year conditional warranty and also includes 10-day replacement policy. 8. How to care for Tatva Natural Latex and Coir Mattress? Always use a mattress protector to protect against dust, spills, and allergens, and get it professionally deep-cleaned twice a year for better hygiene. Do not flip or turn the mattress, avoid ironing on it, and never fold or bend it as it may damage the mattress structure.
